descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-19 Medication Tracker · S18 A row removed in the Medications panel stays gone; the removal asks for confirmation once

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T8 A deleted medication row never comes back unless re-dictated, and each delete asks for confirmation once (no bulk delete). (TFA-94699 AC 5; TFA-94699 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1 The pre-round medication list and the encounter Medication Tracker are one set of rows: a row the pre-round Save Note writes shows in the Post-Round tracker and a change from Save & Extract shows on … (UAT TC-19; TFA-92597 What; TFA-92597 AC 3)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient; pre-round Save Note seeds aspirin and pantoprazole

When Medications panel → Edit → remove pantoprazole → Save Medications; then Save & Extract 'Doing well, plan unchanged.'; then open the pre-round editor and Save Note again on the unchanged pre-round text

Then Removing asks for confirmation exactly once; pantoprazole is gone from the panel and the Post-Round tracker after the Save & Extract; aspirin untouched

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-94699 AC 5 and AC 6 (gate). Blocked: on main the Remove button (MedicationsPanel.tsx, aria-label 'Remove <drug>') drops the row from the draft with no confirmation, and the confirmation belongs to TFA-94699 (in progress), so agent-matrix.sh skips this case. When unblocked, cp1 must also show the confirmation, and every failure is filed under T8's gate. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-19.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
